findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/host-run-usage.md:33-40 the newly-written host_run usage block documents the prompt grammar as a mandatory one-of "( --prompt "<text>" | --promptFile <path> )" and omits the --managedReview flag entirely, but packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:3086 declares managedReview and packages/main/src/handlers/host-run.ts:276-296 enforces the inverse: with --managedReview, passing --prompt/--promptFile is a hard error (line 278), and the real requirement is exactly one of three alternatives (line 296 error text: "provide exactly one of --prompt or --promptFile (or use --managedReview with an exact ReviewRun)"). The same document at lines 126-129 and 175-187 then relies on --managedReview as the formal cross-provider reviewer path, so the operator-facing invocation grammar for this story's headline feature is incomplete and self-contradictory. The block is new in this diff (it adds --deadlineMs/--detach), so this is drift introduced here, not inherited. Fix: list [--managedReview] in the flag block and state the three-way exclusivity.
